name: Epeke Vuyisani
title: UGC Creator | Beauty, Fashion & Lifestyle
tagline: Real faces. Soft light. Content that feels like taste.
about: I make short-form content that feels like a friend showing you something they actually use: a skincare routine in a bright bathroom, a hoodie styled three ways, a tray of frames tried on one by one. I care about light, framing and pacing, and I keep the product honest and central. My work lives across skincare, fashion and accessories, fragrance and grooming, everyday routines and consumer tech, built for TikTok and Instagram Reels.
services: Vertical, social-first videos shot and edited to your brief.
Routines, textures, application and before-you-buy demos.
Outfit stories, try-ons, detail shots and styling variations.
Ritual-style content around scent, shave and personal care.
Your product placed naturally inside an everyday moment.
Clear how-it-works content with close, honest detail.
Reels and TikToks formatted for each platform.
Concepts and alternative hooks to test in your ad accounts.
process: Share the product, audience, platform and goal.
I propose hooks, scenes and a shot list for approval.
Vertical filming, clean edit, captions and sound.
Files delivered in your formats, with agreed revision rounds.
